# @tansy/blog

Turns tansy into a blog: posts, categories, tags, authors, comments and feeds.

```bash
npm install @tansy/blog
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the blog plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/blog.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
